books.title: The Brave Fox
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Felix the fox lived in a forest full of tall pine trees. He was small, but he was very brave.
One autumn morning, Felix heard a cry for help. A little rabbit was stuck in a thorny bush.
The rabbit was scared. 'Please help me,' she cried. 'I cannot get out!'
Felix was careful. He pushed the branches aside with his paws and freed the rabbit.
The rabbit thanked Felix with a basket of carrots. 'You are the bravest fox in the forest!' she said.
From that day on, Felix and the rabbit were the best of friends, and everyone in the forest knew the brave fox.

books.title: The Lost Kite
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: On a windy Saturday, Omar took his red kite to the park. It was shaped like a dragon.
Omar ran across the grass, and the kite flew higher and higher. 'Look at it go!' he shouted.
Suddenly a strong gust of wind pulled the string from his hand. The kite flew away over the trees.
Omar felt sad, but he did not give up. He followed the kite all the way to the other side of the park.
There it was, caught in a low branch. Omar climbed up carefully and set his kite free.
That evening Omar flew his kite again, holding the string extra tight. It was the best flight yet.

books.title: The Talking Parrot
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Lina's grandmother had a green parrot called Coco. Coco could say more than twenty words.
Every morning Coco said, 'Good morning, Lina!' and Lina always answered, 'Good morning, Coco!'
One day Lina lost her favourite blue hair ribbon. She looked under the bed and behind the sofa, but it was gone.
Then Coco flapped his wings and said, 'Under the chair! Under the chair!'
Lina looked under the chair, and there was her ribbon. 'Coco, you are so clever!' she laughed.
Now Lina tells everyone that Coco is not just a parrot. He is the best detective in the whole house.

books.title: The Brave Little Mouse
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Milo was a little mouse who lived in a hole under an old oak tree. He was the smallest mouse in his family, but he had a very big heart.
One stormy night, the wind blew down the bridge over the river, and the mice could not cross to the field where their food grew.
All the big mice were too scared to swim across the cold, fast river. But Milo took a deep breath and said, "I will try!"
Milo jumped onto a big leaf and used a stick to row across the water. The waves were strong, but he did not give up.
At last, Milo reached the other side and brought back seeds for everyone. From that day on, the little mouse was the bravest mouse in the whole forest.
